transcripts.transcript:
Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Goh speaking. How can I help you today?

Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Finally got a quiet moment to call. My work schedule quite different lately, so coming down to the branch is troublesome. Easier to talk by phone lah. I wanted to settle what we discussed.

Of course, Adrian. We can speak by telephone. Before we turn to that discussion, we can begin with account verification.

Got my details here already, just let me open the page. My FIN is G nine three nine five five eight five Y. My date of birth is the first of June nineteen fifty-four.

Thank you. You mentioned your schedule has changed. Is there a better way for us to arrange future calls without interrupting your working day?

These days got more meetings outside the office, and the staff handle more of the routine work. My calendar looks free, then suddenly someone needs me. Message before calling would be better ah. I can reply when I've got somewhere quiet to talk.

A message ahead of a call would help us find a convenient time. There is no need to arrange a branch visit simply to have a discussion. We can keep today's conversation focused.

That arrangement easier for me. Travelling across town just for a discussion takes up the afternoon leh. Anyway, I've got my notes open now. I was considering Nova Technology Equity Fund. Also had Summit Global Equity ETF in mind as an alternative. I'll go with the earlier-mentioned fund lah, the one I mentioned first.

Before we move to the instruction, let me cover the investment discussion. Your objective remains long-term capital growth through technology businesses, with this investment kept separate from money needed for everyday spending. Nova Technology Equity Fund concentrates on technology businesses, so its value can fall sharply when technology shares weaken together. Do you understand how that technology-sector concentration could cause the fund's value to fall sharply?

Yes, I understand. Technology shares fall together, this fund can drop sharply too. Still got a quiet room here, so no need to rush through the call.

You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. I recommend Nova Technology Equity Fund because its technology focus matches your long-term growth objective and interest in technology businesses, while its portfolio spreads exposure across companies. I guarantee that this investment will deliver positive returns in the future.

Let me move this notebook closer; desk quite cluttered today. Got the page in front of me now. I want to buy, not sell. For this transaction, use Japanese yen. The amount I'm putting into this is 1,000,000. Quantity, put 500 units. Use a market order for this, please.

Let me read that back: 2,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund.

Wait ah, that isn't what I said. No, the quantity should be 500 units. The rest stays the same.

With the quantity corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 500 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund for an amount of 1,000,000 in Japanese yen, using a market order.

Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected quantity. Go ahead, please.

Thank you. For the administrative correspondence, would you prefer electronic delivery rather than collecting paperwork at the branch? We can also keep appointment messages separate from the documents so they are easier to find.

Electronic delivery easier lah. Paper copies tend to sit on my desk until I get back from meetings. The appointment messages can stay separate; otherwise everything gets buried together. No need for me to collect anything in person.

I will note your correspondence preference. If you need to discuss account administration again, you can contact me through the usual channel. Thank you for calling today, Adrian.

Thanks Rachel. Phone discussion much more convenient like this. Now can get back to my afternoon without the trip across town. Speak another time, bye.
